cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: More Power, More Problems
cards.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Another complaint about me! My influence now reaches the whole hotel. File it under my name, please, not 'general reception.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm taking you off reception while I investigate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Management attention as well. Record the investigation separately; we shouldn't confuse two levels of interest.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll answer every complaint in writing from the laundry office.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A correspondence operation in another department! Route all the letters there, please. Date order, not room order; I'll show laundry how to run a proper office.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 filing category, A3 separate investigation and A5 date-order correction make expert management celebrate disciplinary burden as widening influence.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 removed reception and B4 laundry work remain restrictions; A aspiration to teach laundry is a response, not established authority.

relationship.evidence: B2 investigation and B4 written complaints are plausible supervisory steps that each fuel A reading.

heightening.evidence: B4 laundry office causes A5 new departmental operation and ordered letters.

specificity.evidence: A1 hotel complaints and B2 removal make disciplinary context legible.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 routing, order and asserted teaching role directly organise the imposed task rather than merely label its meaning.
